units.source_text: 她的声音响彻埃及，她的闺房舞蹈被广泛推广。

en.t: Her voice resounded throughout Egypt, and her chamber dance was widely promoted.

units.source_text: 拯救埃及妇女的工作，也就成为拯救埃及男人的工作，

en.t: The work of saving Egypt's women thus also became the work of saving Egypt's men,

units.source_text: 因此得到男人和女人的感谢，

en.t: and for that reason she received the gratitude of both men and women,

units.source_text: 她也被推崇为给埃及带来真正的爱的幸福的女神。

en.t: and she was also revered as the goddess who brought Egypt the happiness of true love.

units.source_text: 埃及妇女的地位才有提高，

en.t: the status of Egyptian women was finally raised,

units.source_text: 才逐步推行婚姻制度的大改革。

en.t: and a major reform of the marriage system was gradually carried out.
